title: Prove the fallback can win the race
description: Inject a fault, choose an independent monitor and fallback, then compare total response time and evaluation coverage with the scenario's safety boundary.

scenarios.label: Camera occlusion
scenarios.detail: The primary visual path loses scene evidence while the system is moving toward a crossing.
scenarios.safeState: Reduce speed and hold outside the crossing

scenarios.label: Localization jump
scenarios.detail: A map match shifts the estimated pose far enough to invalidate the active trajectory.
scenarios.safeState: Reject the trajectory and stop in the known free-space corridor

scenarios.label: Actuator response lag
scenarios.detail: The measured steering or braking response falls behind the controller's commanded state.
scenarios.safeState: Remove primary authority and command the fastest verified stable response

scenarios.label: Compute deadline overrun
scenarios.detail: Perception and planning output is internally consistent but too old for the current motion.
scenarios.safeState: Discard stale commands and enter the bounded degraded controller

monitors.label: Output-only monitor
monitors.detail: Check the final command but not sensor health, timing, or internal disagreement.

monitors.label: Health and boundary monitor
monitors.detail: Check freshness, subsystem health, uncertainty, and command constraints.

monitors.label: Independent runtime assurance
monitors.detail: Use a simpler, separately justified monitor that can revoke primary authority.

fallbacks.label: Continue degraded
fallbacks.detail: Preserve task progress with reduced sensing and the original route.

fallbacks.label: Limited-motion controller
fallbacks.detail: Reduce speed and authority while moving only inside verified free space.

fallbacks.label: Minimal-risk stop
fallbacks.detail: Sacrifice the mission and transition to the safest reachable stable state.

evidencePlans.label: Nominal simulation
evidencePlans.detail: Test expected scenes and average performance without targeted fault injection.

evidencePlans.label: Scenario and fault matrix
evidencePlans.detail: Cross environment regimes with sensor, timing, compute, and actuator faults.

evidencePlans.label: Closed-loop replay plus field evidence
evidencePlans.detail: Combine simulation, protected incident replays, hardware tests, and monitored operation.
